paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus: perhaps he was Rabbi Eliezer’s younger brother. He was present on the day they appointed Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah; Rabbi Eliezer was then in Lod. He appeared before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Chananyah, who called Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus a student of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai’s student, while he called Rabbi Akiva Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai’s student out of respect for him, although he too was a student of a student. Rashi explains that he was Rabbi Akiva’s student: Sotah, Mishnah at the beginning of chapter 5, mishnah 5 (27b). He did not entertain the possibility that this was the ben Hyrcanus who was the son of Rabbi Eliezer ben Hyrcanus, for Rabbi Eliezer’s son was called Rabbi Hyrcanus, whereas here he calls him Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hyrcanus.
